title: An Explorer's Task
description: An Explorer's Task — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Speak with the Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Exploring The Embercore Path

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak with the Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

Loremaster Vraile would like to speak to you now that you have been to The Embercore Path. He probably wants you to finger-paint some maps for him or some such nonsense. Personally, I don't think you are qualified for finger-painting, but I specialize in giving life or death orders like, Go talk to Loremaster Vraile and Go look at that thing over there, so if he wants you to finger-paint then by the King you will finger-paint!

Well, go on then, talk to Loremaster Vraile!

Turn-in:

Ah, well, hello again. Good to see you are still in one piece!

Client level range: 40–100
